```{r}

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(thematic)
library(tidyverse)
library(gitlink)
library(ggplot2)
library(countrycode)
library(plotly)
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(chattr)


# Check if current computer is WATSON and set path accordingly
if (Sys.info()["nodename"] == "DESKTOP-MMF34H4") {
  fromWATSON <- "C:/Users/rmart/PRINZteam Dropbox/Ralf Martin/patbis2021/data/fromWATSON/"
} else {
  fromWATSON <- NULL
}

```





# Loading data

```{r}


df <- read_parquet("countrymap.parquet")
df=df %>% left_join(read_parquet("istraxes/istrax_global.parquet"))
df=df %>% mutate(cit_id=istrax_global>0)

innos_ev_global <- read_delim(paste0(fromWATSON,"innos_ev_global_2009_2018.dsv"), delim = "\t") %>% select(docdb_family_id, ev)

df=df %>% left_join(innos_ev_global)



```


# Collapsing

```{r}

df_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(ctry_code) %>%
  summarise(
    istrax_global = sum(istrax_global, na.rm = TRUE),
    cit_id = sum(cit_id, na.rm = TRUE),
    pats=n(),
    mean_istrax=mean(istrax_global,na.rm=TRUE),
    mean_ev=mean(ev,na.rm=TRUE)
  )

library(wbstats)

# Get population data from World Bank
population_2018 <- wb_data(
  indicator = "SP.POP.TOTL",
  start_date = 2018,
  end_date = 2018
) %>%
  select(ctry_code = iso2c, population_2018 = SP.POP.TOTL) %>%
  filter(!is.na(population_2018))


# Get income classification data
income_classification <- wb_countries() %>%
  select(ctry_code = iso2c, income_level) %>%
  mutate(high_income_2018 = income_level == "High income")

# Join both datasets to df_summary
df_summary <- df_summary %>%
  left_join(population_2018, by = "ctry_code") %>%
  left_join(income_classification, by = "ctry_code") %>% 
  mutate(notHIC=income_level!="High income")



df_summary=df_summary %>% mutate(patsOpop=pats/population_2018,cit_idOpop=cit_id/population_2018, istraxOpop=istrax_global/population_2018)




# Get country names
country_names <- wb_countries() %>%
  select(ctry_code = iso2c, country_name = country)

# Join country names to df_summary
df_summary <- df_summary %>%
  left_join(country_names, by = "ctry_code")


```


# Analysis


## Fraction of pats with 0 cits

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Calculate fraction of rows where ev equals 0
fraction_ev_zero <- df %>%
  summarise(fraction = mean(ev == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(fraction)

fraction_ev_zero



```

## Fraction of pats in hihg vs low income countriies


```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Calculate fraction of observations by income classification
df %>%
  count(notHIC) %>%
  mutate(fraction = n / sum(n))

```


## Average EV

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Calculate HIC median and 25th percentile
hic_median <- df_summary %>%
  filter(notHIC == FALSE, !is.na(mean_ev)) %>%
  summarise(median_mean_ev = median(mean_ev, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(median_mean_ev)

hic_p25 <- df_summary %>%
  filter(notHIC == FALSE, !is.na(mean_ev)) %>%
  summarise(p25_mean_ev = quantile(mean_ev, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(p25_mean_ev)

# Chart 1: Top 20 high income countries by mean_ev
df_summary %>%
  filter(notHIC == FALSE, !is.na(mean_ev)) %>%
  slice_max(mean_ev, n = 30) %>%
  mutate(country_name = fct_reorder(country_name, mean_ev)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = country_name, y = mean_ev)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hic_median), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hic_p25), color = "orange", linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = hic_median, label = "HIC Median", vjust = -0.5, color = "red", angle = 90, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = hic_p25, label = "HIC 25th Percentile", vjust = -0.5, color = "orange", angle = 90, size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 20 High Income Countries by Average External Value",
    x = "Country",
    y = "Average External Value"
  )

# Chart 2: Top 20 not high income countries by mean_ev
df_summary %>%
  filter(notHIC == TRUE, !is.na(mean_ev)) %>%
  slice_max(mean_ev, n = 30) %>%
  mutate(country_name = fct_reorder(country_name, mean_ev)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = country_name, y = mean_ev)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hic_median), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hic_p25), color = "orange", linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = hic_median, label = "HIC Median", vjust = -0.5, color = "red", angle = 90, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = hic_p25, label = "HIC 25th Percentile", vjust = -0.5, color = "orange", angle = 90, size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 20 Non-High Income Countries by Average External Value",
    x = "Country",
    y = "Average External Value"
  )

# Chart 3: High income countries with average external value below 25th percentile
df_summary %>%
  filter(notHIC == FALSE, !is.na(mean_ev), mean_ev <= hic_p25) %>%
  mutate(country_name = fct_reorder(country_name, mean_ev)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = country_name, y = mean_ev)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hic_median), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hic_p25), color = "orange", linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = 5, y = hic_median, label = "HIC Median", vjust = -0.5, color = "red", angle = 90, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 5, y = hic_p25, label = "HIC 25th Percentile", vjust = -0.5, color = "orange", angle = 90, size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "High Income Countries with Average External Value Below 25th Percentile",
    x = "Country",
    y = "Average External Value"
  )

```
